t:
The House de Doucer wasn't the only family to fall into the trap of vampirism. A similar thing happened to the House de Tristesse. Originally, de Tristesse lived on Umoir, to the east of the market town Al Rihat. Under Skrakan's rule, they traded with humans and did not bother anyone...

Hard times began for the House de Tristesse when Catherina came to power. She banned the trade first, and then banned the House from the allod.

Ademar de Tristesse, the head of the House, had a secret place, where only Kanian hunters could go. It was called Drowsy Woods.

He moved there and took the House and his daughter Annette with him. But it didn't put an end to their troubles. Annette's mother died. Soon, the witch Baba Yaga seduced Ademar, married him, and became Annette's step-mother. She deeply hated her step-daughter. Yaga was jealous, cruel, and so full of herself! Annette was bullied and humiliated. The new wife bossed Ademar around and kept the House on the toes.

But that’s not all. Ademar once brought a hand mirror from his travels. Not an ordinary mirror. It was the notorious Evil Mirror that destroyed Canaan.

Yaga asked the mirror, who was the fairest, and the mirror replied, Annette! The witch got mad and decided to destroy her. Annette ran for her life into the forest, where seven knights lived.

But the witch found her even there... The heroes went out to hunt, and when they returned, she was there, beautiful, pale, not moving or breathing... with an apple in her hand. They guessed that it was Baba Yaga that poisoned the poor thing. They put her in a crystal coffin and left it out there on a high mountain.

Her fiancé Yelisseus killed the witch and broke the crystal coffin.

The witch had cursed Annette. The power of the mirror turned her into a vampire, and the curse took her body and soul. Yelisseus stayed. He hoped he could fight the curse, but he couldn't!

Everyone, who was there with her on the allod, turned into ghouls, just like she was. This is how the House de Tristesse came to worship and protect the Evil Mirror. Some managed to escape, but Drowsy Woods turned into a death trap that no one could approach.
r195526.n: History of Vampires. Page 6. Tragedy in the House de Tristesse.

t:
During the last Great Ball, the House de Desirae gained a victory. Young prince Dakkar ensured it. He was a Summoner. He won the competition against the head of the House de Doucer, Armando. Even though any foul play was forbidden, Armando still took it as a great insult. Once powerful, the House de Doucer had been in decline for half a century after their failed invasion on Kirah. Summoning was Armando's way to regain his former popularity. What a blow it was to be beaten by a boy!

He did what could never be undone. He got involved with Tep. He learned the June blood magic rituals from him and managed to perform the Spark extraction ritual on Dakkar's fiancée, the human girl Svetlana Valir. The young prince tried to lift the curse and reanimate his loved one, but instead, the curse fell on the castle and turned everyone into undead.

Prince Dakkar went into exile. The House de Doucer became a pariah, pursued on every allod. This revenge wasn't good enough for Armando. He tricked Vivien de Ardeur, one of the creators of Galleon Castle. He gave her an artifact, and its power affected and corrupted the whole castle. By that time, the rituals Tep had taught Armando turned Armando and most of the elves in his House into vampires.

Tep wanted to get hold of the technologies that created the Castle. In pursuit of his goal, he needed someone who was involved with the construction. He was lucky to find an ambitious person of low ethics. Armando's wife Camomilla managed to win one of Galleon's creators, Celestine de Ardeur, over to Tep's side. She didn't even have to turn to switch sides! She swore loyalty to the great Summoner just because she wanted to leave a mark in history. Her name was now Nihil. She became an apologist of death and destruction in Tep's service.

Armando was stopped, but the Galleon Castle turned into the Darkblood Citadel forever. It corrupted all visitors with darkness and turned them into vampires. But Raimond and Celestina's brilliant invention didn't go to waste. Armando de Doucer stole the Galleon Castle blueprints for Gorluxor and built a replica. Some time later, after resurrection, Armando used the ship to attack Avilon.

You know what happened next. We defeated them and managed to subdue the ship's mind after a while. The second Galleon Castle has served the Historians well. I hope it will continue to do so.
r195527.n: History of Vampires. Page 5. Armando's Betrayal.

t:
Galleon Castle. A miracle of engineering created by the House de Ardeur. Many are interested in how this place came to be. Well, it's no great mystery... the mystery is how it turned into the Darkblood Citadel...

Originally, the Galleon Castle was erected by the House de Ardeur. Another Great Ball was prepared back then. It's hard to understand if you know nothing about the Great Game of elven Houses, but the competition between the Houses takes place during every Great Ball. To win, a House must create or show something truly outstanding. Such as a union with Kania, which laid the foundation of the League. Or a technology of astral flights. Or the idea of cultural expansion... Something that could change the world.

It was the House de Ardeur that built the first astral ship - a prototype of League's future first fleet. No wonder that this House has been trying to outdo themselves ever since. This is how the idea of the Galleon Castle came about. It was supposed to turn astral into comfortable environment that would feel like the firm ground of allods.

House de Ardeur moved the construction from their own allod Lumenara to Tenebra, de Desirae residence, out of fear of other Houses' spies. House de Desirae assisted them along the way. They were supposed to receive the Galleon Castle after the Great Ball.

The construction was going smoothly. Both Houses were happy about their own engineering and magical genius. But they didn't expect a treacherous blow from an old enemy.
r195528.n: History of Vampires. Page 4. Darkblood Citadel.

t:
The fate of Canaan and his vampire followers has been kept secret for ages.

Still, the vampires appeared here and there, and both humans and elves feared them. The Aro tribes encountered them first...

When vampires appeared, the Aro tribes, ancestors of the Kanians, searched for ways to battle them, but one king went further than others - Vseslav the Sorcerer with his Keepers. They found a way to turn into animals... Wolves, bears, foxes... and other predators.

The problem was, the longer they stayed in their animal form, the more they lost control of their inner beast. One day they got stuck somewhere in the middle.

And now the curse is spread through a bite, just like vampirism. Werebears and werewolves should be distinguished. The former come from intelligent bears. Many wearbears mated with half-bears, half-humans. Today there's human blood in all of them.

The vampire situation improved when human Great Mages took over after the war with orcs. They chased vampires, who span out of control, into the most distant corners of Jule.

They dealt with Canaan himself only in the allod era, when the Vampire Hunters order was created. Their bastion was located in an ancient temple in the mountains.

The Hunters, together with their leader Avelina, followed Canaan for many years. They killed many of his minions, but the final battle took place in the Bastion, when Canaan decided to strike back.

While Avelina was absent, he sneaked into the Bastion and killed everyone inside. The Huntress returned to find the Blood Father standing in the middle of a room among piles of dead bodies.

The legendary battle of Avelina and Canaan was glorified in many songs. Blood Father was struck down by Avelina. His body was taken by the Great Mage Skrakan and buried with great precautions somewhere on Umoir, in a secret coffin.
r195529.n: History of Vampires. Page 3. Canaan's Destiny.

t:
Those events are now known as the Blood Feast. The kingdom was divided, so no one felt safe, and each night was full of terror as people expected to be torn apart by monsters who had recently been their friends, colleagues, or even family...

Finally, the vampire hunt began. Even before the events, the kingdom's Council of Mages, headed by the court mage Pascal, gathered a council, henceforth known as the Conclave of Great Mages. It had an important task: to monitor dangerous areas of magic and prevent potential disasters. The Conclave members were horrified to discover that one of them, Canaan, turned into a vampire. They tried to arrest him, but he and his followers managed to escape. The order was restored in the kingdom...

It seemed that Yrene took a fatal blow. The Blood Feast took its toll. The trust among the elves was gone. Many left the kingdom and spread all over larger territories. The elves scattered around the world and began to form Houses, each with their own set of rules and laws.

Some of the vampires escaped their brothers' fate. They hid in the dark. With the June artifacts, such as the notorious Evil Mirror, they were a threat to the world for a long time. Vampire hunters fought an endless war with vampires. Summoning was banned from the elven society for centuries to come. It could only be studied by apprentices who wanted to become Great Mages. It was closely supervised by the Conclave.
r195530.n: History of Vampires. Page 2. Blood Feast.

t:
History has examples for any kind of situation. Unfortunately, sometimes its lessons are too bitter – so we prefer to forget what happened. That's how it went with the events that darkened the existence of elves soon after the Change...

After Junes had perished, there was no kingdom to compare with Yrene in terms of power. Even the last beggar possessed magic powers. The elites of the elven kingdom sought to be even stronger. They immersed into unexplored magic deeper and deeper.

The mysterious magic of June, the blood magic caught their attention. The Junes were desperate and resorted to it more and more, trying to prevent their downfall. But the blood magic didn't help, and the Junes perished. The ancient ruins of their cities are laden with mysterious artifacts, craved by elven researchers.

Some gifts were toxic. The June knowledge significantly boosted the elven necromancy, but also led to some horrible consequences. Some elves used June artifacts to perform bloody magic rituals... and transformed into vampires. Since that day, they were doomed to the eternal thirst, which could be quenched only with hot blood.
r195531.n: History of Vampires. Page 1. Children of Darkness.

t:
The History of Vampires explains where the vampires came from and follows the tragic history of the Houses de Doucer and de Tristesse.

It's missing some pages.
I have made copies of all the documents that you managed to collect in the Baneful Valley...
r195535.n: Ask about the stories of the Baneful Valley

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 901, House de Doucer wins. Umbert de Doucer comes up with a plan of attack on the Kirah allod and starts a new war with the Empire. Astral ships will be used in this war.

Year 924, House de Blizare wins. After repelling an attack of astral demons, Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare writes a military work about their vulnerabilities and the ways of dealing with them. In the future, this information becomes the basis for the creation of the Order of Demon Hunters.

Year 937, House de Grandeur wins, Estelle di Grander predicts the future. Recorded, her predictions become known as Estelle's Quatrains. The Conclave decides to classify some of the information they contain. Estelle's prophecies rehabilitate the elven Oracles who are now free to practice.

Year 962, House de Ardeur wins. Raymond de Ardeur and his student Celestina de Ardeur solve the mystery of the Imperial astral energy and improve its principles.

Year 990, House de Desirae wins, Dakkar de Desirae demonstrates extraordinary skills in the field of necromancy. From that moment on, the Conclave finally lifts the prohibitions on necromancy.

Year 1021, House de Delice wins, Gala de Delice secured the acquittal of House de Doucer and the vampires. House de Doucer has been restored as a small House, the allod Jigran has been granted to the vampires as a place of residence.
r195536.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 901, House de Doucer wins.…

Year 845, House de Blizare wins, Maximilien de Blizare invents a new potion that greatly speeds up reactions.

Year 265, House de Doucer wins. Great Mage Gramont de Douceur, with the consent of the other Heads of the Houses, creates new rules for the Great Balls. The first Great Ball takes place on the Yoggor allod.

Year 275, House de Vevre wins, Orelina de Vevre writes the poem "The World's End" that describes the history of the Cataclysm and the subsequent events. The second Great Ball was also held on the Yoggor allod, but later it was decided to hold the Ball on the allod of the winner of the last Ball.

t: This information was collected during the Great Ball on Irene... An interesting document written by Adele de Ardeur. I can show it to you.
r195544.n: Ask about the history of the Great Balls

t:
"The final preparations are complete. The desert is completely in my power, and my forces have approached the borders of my former homeland.

Perhaps Tensess and the others recognize the magnitude of what they are up against. I think they suspect that I managed to entice part of the Conclave over to my side. Many are unhappy with the state of affairs in Kania, the constant disputes between the heirs of Valir. I will bring a much needed order.

My students will come to Kania with me. I spent many centuries to find and train the Xadaganians that have the gift of magic. Alas, my subjects have nonexistent magical talents, which they make up for with diligence and obedience.

And of course, I will have the jinn people on my side. My secret weapon! I spent many years searching for their shelters, developing subjugation spells, binding them to lamps and rings...

Finally, my last and most secret tool. The Gray Prince and his numerous spies who are ready to open the gates of the cities for my armies...

In a few years, the entire Kania will be part of my Empire!"

"Where there were only oases in the desert, the walls of cities now rise. The howl of jackals was replaced by the noise of countless caravans.

They are no longer the people of Ugra! They are the Xada people now, the Xadaganians. They don't need to be descendants of a god if they already have a god, and that god is me!

I slayed all the tribal leaders in a sword fight, although I must admit they did not stand a chance against my new powers. But I see beyond all that...

I see a new Empire, cleansed of the mistakes of the past, devoid of the flaws that were so intolerant to me in Kania. My new Empire will be flawless like a sharpened edge. People inhabiting it will not be of flesh and blood, but of stone and steel Having unflinching fortitude, they will be capable of incredible things..."
r195547.n: "Where there were only oases in the desert, the walls of cities now…

t:
"The poverty and wretchedness of local existence is embellished with fairy tales that old people love to tell so much. In the evenings, everyone gathers around campfires to listen to another tale...

Fantasies! Nothing more. Despite having so little, this nation dreams of so much!

They speak of magic! Of dormant jinn kingdoms under the sands that long to awaken. Of treasures in secret caves. Of power that will be bestowed upon whoever finds the passage hidden deep in the mountains.

After laughing about it openly, I agreed to travel to the mountains. Of course we won't find anything there..."
r195548.n: "The poverty and wretchedness of local existence is embellished with…

t:
"The locals! A pale imitation of humans. Dirty, superstitious nomads! "Descendants of the god of Ugra", "chosen" and "undefeated"! Hah!

But they gave me shelter. Their legends vaguely say that a man "who fell from the heavens" will appear in the desert. He will lead their people to world domination. It's laughable. They are just a handful of tribes living in a forsaken desert. That's the only reason they were allowed to exist. What do they know about the world? About the countless cities of Kania? About indestructible elven fortresses? About the Orcs' Horde which was one step away from conquering this continent?

World domination? Truly, this illusion must be the only gratifying thing the exiles have in this desert!"
r195549.n: "The locals! A pale imitation of humans. Dirty, superstitious nomads!…

t:
"What did we know about this place? Our homeland is the land of green forests and fields. Here the golden dunes stretch to the horizon... And it feels like there is no life here.

But this impression is misleading... My arrival was noticed by more than one pair of eyes. Like rocks falling from the heavens, I drew a line of fire across the sky. I saw those who stared at this "omen" with awe and horror.

Who are they? My teacher spoke of other tribes... The powerful Junes, creators of the empire that ruled this continent? The hard-working Zem who built their pyramids along the River Aether? The proud Knos that crossed the oceans on their ships?

But they all went away. Their time ran out.

Finally, my people - the Aro tribes who are now ready to take their place in the sun... There's nothing for them here! There's the fifth tribe... Ugra."
r195550.n: "What did we know about this place? Our homeland is the land of green…

t:
"The desert... the place of my exile...

Betrayed by my sworn brother, dismissed by my teacher, forgotten by my people...

I am no one, and my name was struck from the pages of history that I helped make...

The cursed duel... I could have won it! One thing failed me - my resolve. I was not ready to fight someone I considered a brother! We went through all the hardships together. It made me falter, but not him! He was ready to crush his brother in the name of his ideals. Well, now I understand what I should have done... I only need to cross this...

Desert... the place of my exile..."
Nezeb! The great conqueror and founder of Xadagan, he is still highly revered in the Empire. Few people can say they knew him closely... But you managed to learn part of his story.

"Kania ceded its territories to Nezeb, and this gave rise to a new Empire - the Xadagan Empire. Of course, there is still much to be done. The conquest is not over yet. Soon the whole world will submit to our rule.

For now... I'll retreat into the shadows. With a supply of dragon blood, I will exist for centuries, guarding the treasures of our Emperor. The desert offers ideal conditions for hiding what needs to be hidden. Artifacts that grant power over jinns. Treasures that can buy anyone. Knowledge that must be unattainable for the time being...

I will find those who will help me and Nezeb without realizing it. Those who consider him their enemy but serve his interests. Everyone who is unhappy with the current situation in the Empire. It will be the brotherhood of the last shelter."
r195554.n: "Kania ceded its territories to Nezeb, and this gave rise to a new…

t:
"I was happy to see your new land. It's so different from the northern countries!

Kania lost the core that allowed it to survive the wars with the Orcs. The former unity is only a memory now: the land is torn apart by disputes and squabbles. The Valir grandchildren are ready to rip out each other's throats for a shred of power. Tensess is too soft to keep them in line.

People are tired of constant squabbles. They remember the hero of the war. You!

It's time to come back and claim what is rightfully yours!"
r195555.n: "I was happy to see your new land. It's so different from the northern…

t:
"You have changed so much over the years, my friend... Really, I did not expect to hear from you again. Time spares no one!

If only you knew what I had to do to get my hands on that thing that would extend my life... The Conclave jealously guards its secrets, and Tensess no longer trusts me.

The sacrifices I made to get a little drop of dragon blood? I won't talk about it. I'm glad to know that you were able to find one of the hearts here, in the deserts of the south. Although it's upsetting that you remembered me so late!

But our alliance still stands. Kania awaits it hero."
r195556.n: "You have changed so much over the years, my friend... Really, I did…

t:
"My dear Nezeb, why did you reject our plan? Why did you agree to this insane duel?

We had been preparing for so long... Placed our people in certain positions, hid caches with weapons... We were ready to set out and dethrone the emperor of Valir!

And you ruined everything... Now I stand among the endless sands with no idea how to find you. My people can search every street in the bustling cities of the north. But here in the south, in the barren and deadly desert, I am powerless."
r195557.n: Read the story of the Gray Prince

t: Gray Prince! A truly mysterious personality which many believed did not exist at all. But you managed to collect important information about them.
r195558.n: Ask about the story of the Gray Prince

t:
"Hinanna strove to be equal to her elder sister. She strove to surpass her. At that time Hirkalla already possessed the power of Darkness and ruled the World of Death. Jealous of her sister's might, Hinanna wanted to seize what she possessed.

She gathered secret forces, wore her best clothes and jewelry, and embarked on the journey. She approached the colossal gates of the underground world, awoke the guardian by banging on the doors, and fiercely demanded that he let her in.

But one cannot enter this world without obeying its laws. Hinanna had to give all her clothes and jewels along with all her powers to pass the gates of Ganzir. And she fell under the power of the World of Death ruled by her sister. The young goddess never expected this. She was dead while still being alive, condemned to the worst fate imaginable.

I knew not what became of Sarn. I knew not of the fate of the younger daughter. Although I felt sorry for the gullible Hinanna that fell victim to her own stupidity, there was a much worse threat hanging over our worlds. The Architect came from a faraway world. The heartless Order where mind and will were one. Nihaz and I had to fight the invader.

I came out of my shelter every once in a while. Having destroyed an emissary of the new enemy, I felt that my lost daughter and a forgotten friend were once again close. When the ship of the missionary of the Order was torn to pieces by my Great Trees, he fell like a ball of fire upon the lifeless world. I gazed upon the barren land and saw only vile dragons loyal to Nihaz. I realized that they would summon their King, so I left this world. I returned to Eden but never gave up my attempts at finding my lost daughter.

What is mortals' time to me? A blink. It's been five thousand years. My heart is still yearning."
r195560.n: "Hinanna strove to be equal to her elder sister. She strove to surpass…

t:
"'We were wondering what he really wanted. Sarn suggested that his true goal was to become more powerful. He destroyed many gods, including his former allies, Gods of Death and Chaos, and took their power.

Disturbed by what happened to my husband, I started to avoid battles. Eden, the world of Life, became my shelter. The story was simple. I knew that my daughter Hinanna would gain enough experience and wisdom to eventually become the ruler of the divine garden. The Garden of Eden was hidden from Nihaz. Everyone was safe. The war was continued by Sarn, Nihaz's complete opposite. He successfully destroyed legions of darkness marching through our worlds.

But even a great warrior can be betrayed. There was a traitor in our ranks. To my surprise, it was Hinanna. Jealous of her sister and the glory she achieved by serving Nihaz, she decided to chain sides. Hinanna lured Sarn into a trap. After fighting Nihaz, the God of Light was captured."
r195561.n: "'We were wondering what he really wanted. Sarn suggested that his…

t:
"Hirkalla, our beloved daughter, then joined Nihaz. With all her heart, she accepted his teaching about the freedom of choice, the breaking of the great circle, and giving the mortals freedom to become gods.

Our worlds were thrown in a long war. Nihaz and the other gods fought against me and Father Time. Sarn, the God of Light, was one of his main enemies in this war.

Nihaz's efforts bore fruit. Gods died one after another. The most terrible thing happened when Nihaz and the others dealt a fatal blow to Father Time. They overcome him near the World of Destruction where he engaged in a battle with the Darkness. Only a God can kill a God. Nihaz dealt a fatal blow to Father Time who was already wounded, then took away his power. Since then, he became something greater than the God of Darkness, but he did not achieve what was after."
r195562.n: "Hirkalla, our beloved daughter, then joined Nihaz. With all her…

t:
"She was brought to us, and we condemned her for her disobedience. She silently accepted it and went to live in exile. Since that day, Nihaz was unwelcome in Eidos. Unfortunately, by that time many of the gods were on his side. The creators that didn't want the destruction of their worlds listened to him. This rebel was loved not only by those who belonged to the Darkness but also those from the Domains of Chaos and Death. Even gods of elements joined the rebellion.

I didn't expect him to turn to mortals, helping them fight monsters and improving their lives. His was praised for giving knowledge and teaching crafts. Nihaz's gifts were poisonous, but he gave them generously to his followers. Mortals who sought immortality and divinity all rebelled.

Anxiously we have watched from our thrones the growing numbers of Nihaz's army. There was still time until another cycle of destruction and rebirth, but this war couldn't wait. It came to us."
r195563.n: "She was brought to us, and we condemned her for her disobedience. She…

t:
"In doubt, Hirkalla decided to talk to him. She gathered herself, and went to the throne of Darkness to dispel her fears. At that time, Hinanna took interest in another mortal, and the God of Darkness was left alone.

They had a long conversation. Hirkalla voiced her doubts, and Nihaz answered them. Few people knew what they were talking about, but Hinanna returned from her journey and witnessed the end of the talk.

The younger sister learned that Nihaz wanted to overthrow me and Father Time. He considered our concept of the world despicable. He mocked the idea of the circle and the renewal of worlds. Nihaz believed that the gods should make mortals our equals, teach them the laws of creation and eternal life.

Hinanna rushed to our divine throne straight away to warn us of the betrayal. I was furious. I ordered that Hirkalla be brought before me."
r195564.n: "In doubt, Hirkalla decided to talk to him. She gathered herself, and…

t:
"Hinanna was happy to see new faces. She and Nihaz, the God of Darkness, traveled between worlds, watched the fates of mortals, learned their secrets, discovered ancient artifacts of past eons.

The power of the new God of Darkness grew by the year. Ancient monsters, who still remembered the Forgotten, accepted him. None of us had any objections. The Darkness was the natural opposite of the Light, and the Domain required a master. At that time Father Time and I considered him an ordinary "Master of Darkness," one of many. As other gods, he was supposed to start a war and fight the Light, and finally perish, like the Forgotten before him. This is what we thought, so we never worried.

Only Hirkalla sensed that the circle has changed. We considered her too young to rule the Domain of Death. She was in charge of the Guardians of Ganzir who ruled the postmortal fates of all living in our worlds. Thanks to this, she saw that Nihaz was helping, teaching, and protecting mortals as best he could in his travels with Hinanna. She realized that their faith in him gave him even more power."
r195565.n: "Hinanna was happy to see new faces. She and Nihaz, the God of…

t:
"Millions of years passed since the victory over the Forgotten. The new god of the Domain of Darkness appeared. Hinanna, the younger sister, brought him to the door of Eidos. We accepted him and allowed him to take the vacant place. Each of the gods was supposed to played a role. The God of Darkness was accepted in our domain.

Hinanna's decision did not surprise me. She was a beautiful young goddess who was also stubborn, moody, gullible, and impulsive. She traveled the worlds a lot, found her chosen ones among gods and mortals, toyed with their lives.

At some point, the mysterious God of Darkness attracted her attention. No one knew where he had come from. Some thought he was a mortal who managed to become a god. This was extremely rare back then.

Hinanna showed him the way to Eidos, even though her sister Hirkalla warned her that his intentions weren't pure. There was something sinister about the traveler, so she decided to keep an eye on him."
r195566.n: "Millions of years passed since the victory over the Forgotten. The…

t:
"Many gods fell in the war with the Forgotten. Many worlds were destroyed. The survivors gathered in Eidos where the primal images of creation are stored. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

I set to work, creating new worlds to replace what was destroyed. I created the twelve inner worlds first, in accordance with the number of Domains. Each of them should have been led by one of the survivors or newly born gods.

Sarn was one of the survivors, the greatest hero of the past war. He rightfully took the place of the God of Light.

Father Time and I chose two young goddesses among the new gods: Hirkalla and Hinanna. They were supposed to lead the Domains of Life and Death.

Only the Domain of the Forgotten, the Domain of Darkness remained without a ruler. None of the surviving gods wanted the responsibility."
r195567.n: "Many gods fell in the war with the Forgotten. Many worlds were…

t:
"Each world was once created. At the moment of creation its death was predefined. Father Time knows no pity. He watches the sand of time in his hourglass.

There's a point in the circle that is called Judgment Time. Ancient prophecies come true. War is raging in multiple worlds. The Twilight of the Gods is imminent. This is the time when the figures on the board change. The wheel turns. Those who was on top will fall. Those who were beneath will rise.

This is the fate of the world predetermined by me, the All-Mother, and by Father Time. Evil against Good. Evil rises over Good for just an instant but its fate is predetermined as well. It will fall. The Good will win, there is no other way. The sacrifice is great, but after night comes day. This is the law that we established.

This is what happened last time. The ancient God of Darkness, now known as the Forgotten, has risen in all of his power. The worlds are burning, seized by the legions of Darkness. But the God of Light Sarn has also risen. He led the resistance against the Darkness and destroyed the Forgotten once and for all. This was predetermined. Everything happened just as we had planned.

The new day has come. The circle is turning once again."
r195568.n: "Each world was once created. At the moment of creation its death was…

t:
"All that has been created will perish.

All that has perished will be recreated.

The existence is a great circle. There is no creation without destruction. There is no destruction without creation.

The circle has no beginning or end.

The divine couple has always existed: the All-Mother and Father Time. I, All-Mother, is the goddess of life and creation. Father Time is the god of death and destruction. Together we led our worlds through the cycles of births and deaths. We created and destroyed.

We were not alone. Our passion gave birth to our divine children, subject to us. Each of them played their own role. Each of them obeyed the universal laws. There were twelve Domains in my hierarchy. Each Domain was responsible for a single power. Each Domain had a master.

Only I, the All-Mother, the goddess of creation, and my divine husband Father Time, the god of destruction, were eternal Lords of our Domains. Other gods were immortal and lived very long lives which ultimately had to end. The circle kept going, and gods were destined to die.

Many years have passed."

Well, the value of such data is difficult to underestimate, because this is the story of the creator of the gods herself. Of course, as historians, we must approach everything with skepticism, but this narrative is very important as an outsider's view of the struggle between Nihaz and Sarn.
r195570.n: Learn the story of the All-Mother

t:
The threshold is in sight.

Within reach...

But wait, listen -

Bells are ringing!

This means the Orcs

Attacked viciously again.

The brothers did not wait -

Rushed to help!

A hard-won victory -

The brothers survived

Miraculously in this battle.

Such is the will of Fate!

Accepting the Threads,

The Gibberling brothers

Resigned themselves

To their great fate.

Future alliances

Needed a base

They were destined to build.

Votin gave Thorri

His mighty troops,

Lok will appease the Zvergs.

Wald will think of a way

To approach the harsh Pridens.

Great-grandchildren will continue

Their Threads in the Pattern.

What is meant to be will happen!

The Orcs will be gone from Isa!

Sagas will remember

Thorri, Lok, and Wald!

The glory of the Gibberlings

Is preserved for centuries!
r195572.n: The threshold is in sight. Within reach... But wait, listen - Bells…

t:
The brothers found there

A strange old man

With a white beard,

Wearing scarlet clothes.

"Are you called Num?"

Lok asked fearlessly.

"Teach us, old one,

How to avoid Fate!"

"Foolish children!"

Num said angrily.

"In vain

You came to my halls!

I do know of a way

To avoid fate.

But it is infeasible

For the Sparks of mortals!

To argue with fate,

You must be free

Of all the chains

And fetters of the world.

But you are held tightly

By the Thread of Fate,

A vigilant Weaver

Spun it before your birth."

The brothers listened,

And in heavy thoughts

Set out for home.

Their families were waiting.
r195573.n: The brothers found there A strange old man With a white beard, Wearing…

t:
As the storm subsided,

They said goodbye to the guest,

And set out.

Many days passed.

Thorri often lifted

The hammer when necessary.

Many different creatures,

Some of them nameless,

He struck down with a blow,

Powerful and brave.

Lok scouted out the land.

With his cunning tricks,

He sneaked into the dwellings

Of snow giants.

After stealing food,

He returned to his brothers.

Wald, full of advice,

Knew the habits of monsters

And taught his brothers

How to avoid them.

Thus they reached the sea.

The end of their journey was close.

Massive mountains nearby

Were the borders of this world.

There, in the distance,

Burned a flame brighter than the sun.

It was their destination,

The end of distant wanderings.
r195574.n: As the storm subsided, They said goodbye to the guest, And set out.…

t:
Thorri swung his hammer

At the evil spirit!

But suddenly the uninvited guest

Said quietly,

"Who are you and why are you here?"

The brothers were surprised.

"We are Gibberlings

Looking for the house of Num."

"Like you, I once searched

For the House of the Creator...

The road was not easy,

I fell, killed by Frost."

"We do not fear Frost!"

Thorri answered.

"It is worth fearing

The Evil God of Cold.

Here he reigns supreme,

Eradicating life.

The deadly frost

Kills outright.

Be afraid to meet

The ice maiden here.

If you look even once

Into the eyes of an Isfrun,

You will turn to ice,

And your life force will fade.

Even the Junes fear

The powers of the harsh ice.

There are many other

Creatures of nightmare here.

Ice worms,

Jotunns and Wargs...

If you go further,

It will be even more dangerous.

Icy expanses

Are not for the living!"

"We will reach our goal,"

Said the brothers.

"The Threads of our Fate

Have become stronger!

Thank you for your advice...

What is your name?"

The dead one told them,

"They used to call me Nagle."
r195575.n: Thorri swung his hammer At the evil spirit! But suddenly the uninvited…

t:
The north received the brothers,

Where the radiance of the sky

Illuminates the earth

But does not warm it.

The path is long and difficult,

The journey takes many days.

There is nothing but ice and rocks,

And spoils are scarce.

Every day is shorter

Under the dim sun,

The night grows boundlessly,

Darkness brings cold.

One night a storm

Wakes up the brothers.

A veil of snow

Covers everything around them.

They see through the snowstorm

That someone is approaching -

A silhouette

With a shaky gait.

Once the fire dispelled

The darkness that hid the image,

The brothers were horrified:

It was a frozen corpse!

Features and clan marks were hidden

Under the iron mask.

His armor was covered

With hoarfrost patterns.
r195576.n: The north received the brothers, Where the radiance of the sky…

t:
Wise Ilko said,

"Num's house is unknown.

But there are signs

That can show the way.

When you see a Rainbow,

He is at the edge

Farthest from you.

Look there.

Where the sky shines,

From horizon to horizon,

Num will be close,

You can find him.

Where the winds were born

And the fires of volcanoes,

There are traces of creation,

And Num's abode.

But those brave ones

Who do not believe in fate

And who want to fight it

Should remember this:

By challenging the might

That is stronger than gods,

Brave madmen

Will bring doom."

"We will not be stopped

By threats of Fate,

A warrior does not fear

Empty words,"

So saying,

The warriors left.

The path took them far away,

To a place full of signs.
r195577.n: Wise Ilko said, "Num's house is unknown. But there are signs That can…

t:
"In our villages

We have these maidens.

Amorous for a day only,

And then - nothing,"

Lok said jokingly.

The brothers nodded:

"This is no good!

We need a sure way!"

Ilko thought for a while,

Then said,

"If you don't wish to wait

For the Star of Fortune...

There are other sagas

Which sing about marvels

About the one who created

All the living things.

He rarely appeared,

But whoever saw him knows:

Num is the creator of the living.

He must be wiser than all of us."

"That's right, Ilko,

Since he is the father to all of us,

He must know for real,

How to escape fate.

How do we find

Num who is invisible?

If he has a house,

Maybe that's where he is?"
r195578.n: "In our villages We have these maidens. Amorous for a day only, And…

t:
The path took them far away,

To the foot of Muspel

Where good Heidruns

Settled among the grass.

The Gibberlings were greeted

By Ilko, the chief of the horned ones.

The people welcomed the guests,

Offering mead.

"Tell us, wise one,

How to argue with Destiny?

How to avoid Fate,

What do the Threads say?"

The Heidrun chief said,

"Yes, Fate is harsh.

What it decided to weave

Will surely happen.

We gave this evil force

A different name.

We call it the Weaver

That spins Threads.

But we believe

That another power exists.

It gives a chance

To those it favors.

If Luck loves

Her chosen one,

They will avoid Fate

And deceive the Threads.

But while she falls in love quickly,

She falls out of it just as easily.

The circle will come around again,

And luck will pass."
r195579.n: The path took them far away, To the foot of Muspel Where good Heidruns…

t:
The maiden Seida's

Speeches have faded.

The Gibberling brothers

Conferred for a long time.

"You won't scare us!"

Thorri said,

"While my hammer is in my hand,

I will not accept this fate!"

"If the pattern is known,

And not yet woven...

We must take the Threads into our hands

And fool Fate!"

So said Lok,

The cunning trickster.

Wald, after much thought,

Supported the idea.

"Since Seida does not know

How to avoid Fate,

We will seek advice

From other peoples."

So it was decided,

And there was no reason to delay.

On the same day, the three brothers

Set off on another journey.
r195580.n: The maiden Seida's Speeches have faded. The Gibberling brothers…

t:
"But there are sprouts of hope

Amidst the nightmare,"

Seida said again,

"Isa will survive!

A new world will arise

From the wreckage of the old ones,

Great-grandfather, Prophetic Ash Tree

Will be our salvation.

But Fate is treacherous!

Centuries later

Trouble will come again,

Darkness will cover the whole world.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

And the flower of hope

Will bloom at the Tree,

The news will rush further

To the wonderful land of stars.

This is just the beginning.

I see an ominous city,

It is full of the dead,

Summoned against their will.

Light and darkness in battle

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."
r195581.n: "But there are sprouts of hope Amidst the nightmare," Seida said…

t:
In the morning, early,

When it's dark,

And the fog is still

Over the water,

Three brothers left the house

And went to the square.

They saw a maiden there,

Black as midnight.

"Glorious is your path, brothers!"

That was Seida's voice.

"I ask you to hear

What the Threads promise us."

"Tell me, sister,"

Lok intervened quickly.

"Will we be rid of the Orcs?

Will we drive them out completely?"

Seida answered,

"Sagas will sing about you,

They will carry your feat

Through the centuries to your descendants.

But I see dangers

That threaten the whole of Isa.

Horrible fate awaits us!

The power of insidious Fate!

The Threads of the universe

Tell me this:

Soon the world will plunge

Into the void of oblivion!

The roots of the world will crack,

Rocks will fall into the abyss,

And sea waters

Will boil all at once.

The wolf will swallow the sun,

And the stars will die out.

Darkness will swallow Isa,

Devouring everything.

Many souls will die,

Many words will be forgotten,

And the people of Isa

Will perish in the pitch darkness!

That moment is called 'Yok',"

So said Seida.

The brothers fell silent,

Horrified…
r195582.n: In the morning, early, When it's dark, And the fog is still Over the…

t:
The home was now

Only one day away.

Thorri said to Lok

One night in camp,

"I wish we could go back,

Drive the Orcs back to the Humans.

Save our home

From this endless threat."

"That’s right, brother!"

Lok nodded, thinking,

"It’s a pity we are few in number,

And we have no dragons!

I wish we could get

More weapons

From the wise Heidruns,

Praidens, or Zvergs."

They kept going,

Talking all the while

About upcoming battles.

Look - they are home!

In celebration of another victory,

A feast was held.

Brothers were honored,

With raised cups.

Many Gibberlings

Drank beer there,

Ate fish

And a lot of cheese.

And tales were told,

Each better than the last,

Around the mead hall

Deep into the night.
r195583.n: The home was now Only one day away. Thorri said to Lok One night in…

t:
The journey home was long

The brothers whiled it away

In conversation.

Lok said, thoughtful:

"And where, brothers,

Did these Orcs come from?

Old man told us

They didn't exist!"

"They say the Orcs once lived

In the warm lands of the south

Far away from here.

But they went overseas -

Humans drove them out.

And also dragons,"

Said Wald

Wo knew the sagas.

"What are Humans?"

Lok asked.

"Humans are Humans,
We have not met them.

But the Orcs know

That somewhere in the south,

Where there is enough land,

There are plenty of them.

There would be even more of them,

If not for the dragons

That burn down

Everything they see.

The dragons feel hatred

For all the living.

The Orc nomads' camps

Died in flames.

After leaving the steppes,

And building boats,

The Orcs moved straight

To Isa as a horde.

The brothers were quiet

For the next part of the journey.

They thought about Orcs,

Humans, and dragons.
r195584.n: The journey home was long The brothers whiled it away In conversation.…

t:
Numerous Orcs

Were slain by Thorri's hammer.

Many were scared into fleeing

Straight into Lok's traps.

Then came an avalanche

Of iron shields.

The hird's weapons clanged,

Sharp spears gleamed.

Scarlet flowers

Bloomed on Isa's snow.

The Gibberlings' fury

Spared no Orc.

And the enemies fled

In a terrible panic.

It is true that in unity

Was the Gibberlings' strength!

"It's time to go home!"

Thorri told the brothers.

There were spoils:

Silver, gold,

Wonderful armor,

Marvelous weapons!

They would have something to show

To Votin and the others!
r195585.n: Numerous Orcs Were slain by Thorri's hammer. Many were scared into…

t:
The years went by

Quickly for the brothers,

And their father's troops

Grew bigger and stronger.

The time came for vengeance

On the Orc people!

The old Votin

Sent the sons to battle.

Thorri chose a hammer

Forged by the Zvergs

And left his father's house

Without saying a word.

Lok said goodbye

To his mother and father,

To his uncles and aunt,

And other relatives.

Wald said a few things

At the threshold of the house.

He promised to return

Once the Orcs were defeated.

The three brothers left,

Watched by sharp eyes.

And words followed them,

Full of spells.

It was a maiden

Of a different kind.

She was called black,

Her fur darker than soot.

Her name was Seida.

Braiding threads

In wonderful patterns,

She saw clearly

Signs and omens

In the Fabric of the Universe.

Regarding the fate of the three brothers

Seida was silent.
r195586.n: The years went by Quickly for the brothers, And their father's troops…

t:
Evil storms raged,

White snow fell,

The house stood strong,

Steady and unshakeable.

He who was the oldest

Among the harsh leaders,

Became a father for the first time -

To three brothers.

Thorri was the first,

Lok was next,

Wald came last,

Votin was their father.

Three Gibberlings -

Their sprout was strong!

It was noisy in the house,

Fun every day!

The children were growing up,

Year after year.

Thorri boasted of his strength,

Lok was the most cunning of all.

Wald loved to listen,

Sitting next to his father:

What others say,

Who believes what.

Who brings news

To their home.

At this time,

News was the same:

Hordes of evil Orcs,

Who came uninvited,

Besieged again

The Gibberling lands.

They burn, break, destroy,

Everything that can be touched.

They are getting close

To the Ash Tree.

The Gibberlings seek

Salvation in the sea.

Votin with his troops

Defends the Great Tree.
r195587.n: Read the Saga of Three Gibberling Brothers

t: It's a unique chronicle in a special style. There are a few embellishments, of course, but it tells us about the history of the North and Isa. It's good that you've heard it. Now everyone can hear it.
r195588.n: Ask about the Saga of Three Gibberling Brothers

t:
Greetings!

I am a member of the Order of the Chronographs, a special department within the Historians' organization.

Our task is to continuously document all the information that comes to us. Any data will be recorded and subsequently transferred for general use to the archive on the Nea allod where our permanent base is located.
r195589.n: Greetings! I am a member of the Order of the Chronographs, a special…

t: Sarang Gahidzha is the holder of a dubious record - he disassembled his own tomb into individual stones in one hour and seventeen minutes. He's located on the top floor of Yasker's Tower and is available to train all new disassemblers.

The Freeborn are a coalition of various minor races that have gathered in Pridonsk in the Dead Sea. The Empire turns a blind eye to their activities since they see no harm in it. However, evil tongues say that they are in cahoots with the drug mafia. And others say they are at feud with them. If you figure out what's actually going on, you can get rewards from Purk the Hasty and Grum the Thrifty.
r195618.n: The Freeborn are a coalition of various minor races that have gathered…

t: It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.
r195631.n: Ask about the Demon Hunters' quartermasters

t: The Keeper of Peace, who serves the Master in the Citadel on the Isle of Revelation, is ready to provide those who join the ranks of his army with items of their allies - the Wormfaces and Draconids. And the Equilibrium Keeper can be found on the Twilight Isle at the outpost of the Master's forces.
r195643.n: Ask about the Master's Army quartermaster

t: So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.

The Order of Compassion was founded under Yasker's orders in the year 972. The goal of the Order is to spread of the teachings of the Trinity Church and help Imperial citizens wherever they are found.
Its members are called the Servants of the Light, and they consist of both courageous Xadaganian girls and the wise women of the Arisen. They sell drops of mirra which will aid you greatly in your travels.
r195651.n: Ask about the Servants of the Light

t: These days Crazystorm the Merciless holds the position of Commander of the Imperial Sentinels. He completely re-examined the goals of the Sentinels and redirected all of their activities. Their main goal is no longer to fight the Astral demons, but to combat the insidious actions of the League.
r195684.n: Ask about the Commander of the Imperial Sentinels

t:
The Empire is well known for valuing its citizens. That's why only in the Empire can you meet the all of your important officials.
Absolutely anyone can visit Yasker's Tower and personally meet with the leader of the City Council, the Imperial Sentinels, the Orcs, or the Arisen. You can even meet Yasker himself! No official is above meeting with the citizens they serve!

The postal service was created to ease communications between citizens of the Empire. Employees of the service, called postal workers, can be found anywhere. They are always ready to tell you everything you need to know about letters and packages, and to quickly deliver your correspondences.
r195697.n: The postal service was created to ease communications between citizens…

t:
Semer Khendjer is the Imperial Guild Master. He oversees the creation of guilds. Guilds are official organizations formed by citizens for the purpose of pursuing a common goal.
Membership in a guild is highly encouraged by the Empire - I'm sure you'll find the benefits are invaluable. You should visit him on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.
r195701.n: Semer Khendjer is the Imperial Guild Master. He oversees the creation…

t: The oracle Sarbaz Segret can be found outside of Yasker's Tower. If you don't know what you should do in life, or if you're afraid you'll miss something important in the future, then I would suggest you talk to him. His visions are invaluable.

In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them on the second floor of Yasker’s Tower. Ernest Sechin will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Slap the Furious - about rating combats, and Yaskul Sekhet - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.
r195707.n: In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open…

t: Do you think you might make a decent agitator? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Yasker's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world.  And you can help them. You can find out the details from Angelika Berezkina, a representative of the Tycoons. She can be found near the bank in Yasker's Tower.
r195717.n: Do you think you might make a decent agitator? Your skills will not go…

t: Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Vladimir Kostin, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Victory Park.
r195719.n: Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical.…

t: After the events on Ammer, there are three Orders in our world - the Order of Progress, the Order of Creation, and the Order of Balance. By joining them, and gaining Order Prestige, you will be able to acquire special prizes that Caeda, the Order Quartermaster, can bestow on you. You can find her in the Astral Academy.

Runes are special items that are linked to the power of the Great Martyrs. They can increase your power when placed in your weapons and armor. Every citizen should meet with Master Semer Nemar for an in-depth tutorial about the use of runes. He can be found on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.

As I said before, the Empire puts a lot of effort into uncovering the secrets of the world. Recently a Xadaganian named Mark Staritsyn was appointed the Keeper of Secrets.
It's his job to systematically research and solve these mysteries. All citizens that have information regarding any riddles, mysteries, secrets, or even gossip are instructed to report to him.
r195729.n: As I said before, the Empire puts a lot of effort into uncovering the…

t: To the north of Nezebgrad there is a port where ships regularly travel through the Astral to other parts of the Empire. Recently, most of the Empire's efforts are focused on transporting Imperial soldiers to the Holy Land where a war is raging.

Portals are a quick and reliable way to move between different territories. Now, thanks to increased prosperity and recent developments in science and magic, portals have been set up across all parts of the Empire. t:
Discords between the Church of Light and the Trinity Church started to emerge many years ago. In our days, followers of different churches only meet each other on a battlefield, but back then marriages between Kanians and Xadaganians were not that uncommon. You know, Xadaganian girls were crazy about elves! Eventually the religious controversy forced two churches to forbid mixed marriages.
Many hearts were broken... Can you imagine the terrible fate of unlucky lovers? But there was a brave man, a priest, who ignored the interdiction and continued to unite the loving hearts, keeping their secrets safe. Nobody knows if he was a Kanian or Xadaganian, and even his name is sunk into oblivion.
But his act of bravery is remembered! Nowadays both the League and the Empire are celebrating the Love Festival - holiday where there is no place for boredom and frustration! Find joy, celebrate and don't forget to present gifts of love to your beloved ones!

Arrows of Passion are unique arrows - they strike right into the heart! Shoot an arrow into the one whose hand you want to win, and see how they light up with a smile. After that, everything depends on you!
But love should be mutual, right? That's why each arrow you shoot leaves a small present for you - a Gift of Admiration, which you can find in your Valuables.
But there is no love without trials, and Arrows of Passion are not given away for free. Fight, win and you will get them as trophies.
Oh, I almost forgot... the arrows have an unpredictable effect - sometimes they arouse strong emotions which blind the target completely. And if you are the lucky one to be blinded, come to me and I will help you.

t:
A best friend is so near and dear that you could easily trust them with your life or light-heartedly lend them your mount. It is as easy as one, two, three! Enter your stable, choose a mount you would like to lend and share it! If your best friend has an empty slot, the mount you have chosen will gallop right into it, and all their Incarnations will be able to ride it as well! It's just as easy to return it, you only need to open the stable.
There are, however, two restrictions. First, a mount whose rank is 5 or higher is faithful to you, so make sure to share only mounts of ranks 1 to 4. Second, color patterns belong to you and cannot be shared.

Who may you safely lend your Astral ship? Why, your best friend, of course! Enter the hangar together, summon your ship and lend it to your best friend. The things they can do to the ship are the same as you can do: summon, undock from hangars, travel to Astral isles, enter battles, take damage and repair it. One thing they are unable to perform, is changing your ship's devices.
You cannot summon your ship while your best friend is holding it. To get it back, you have to enter the hangar together once again and ask for it. The ship will automatically return to you once your friendship is over.
Bear in mind, that all cargo on the ship will disappear as soon as your best friend gets hold of your ship!
Once a half an hour you may teleport to each other, provided that you both are not in combat. When you're done, you may teleport back to your initial location.

Normally two heroes with a significant difference in levels cannot go down to the same dungeon or Astral Isle. This rule does not affect best friends. However, the stronger best friend is not able to just smash the enemy. Instead, they cover their best friend's back and support them. The little one thus obtains five new abilities: one increases damage, another protects from enemies' spells, the third one heals, the fourth one casts fear on the enemy, and the last one teleports the party to the dungeon entrance, just like Mage's Sanctuary. Best friends can invite other heroes to their party, but the stronger best friend's abilities do not apply to them.
